operating_point.chosen_on: 07-11, the hours the app will actually run
operating_point.note: Thresholds apply to the MEAN SCORE over the last 11 frames (5.3 s), not to a single frame - so `on`/`off` are lower than they would be per-frame. Averaging the raw score rather than rounding each frame first is worth 115 ad-seconds/hour and two thirds of the flicker. See trainer/smooth.py.
